mutants.description: Mutant 1: WhalleyWilmott bandwidth computes quadratic (1/2) power instead of cubic (1/3) asymptotic scaling law.
Mutant 2: CVaR calculates simple sample mean loss instead of conditional tail expectation beyond alpha quantile.
Mutant 3: DeepHedger leaks unconstrained scaled delta unbounded above 1.0.
Mutant 4: DeltaHedger assumes zero transaction costs and ignores transaction cost drag in accounting.
Mutant 5: WhalleyWilmottHedger continuously rebalances to target delta regardless of no-trade band boundaries.
